title: DLER: Doing Length pEnalty Right - Incentivizing More Intelligence per Token via Reinforcement Learning

rs.key_step: 简单超长归零reward配group-mean后batch-std、较高upperclip、过滤全零/全正组重采样。
rs.why_non_obvious: 效率改善可来自优化与采样而非复杂penalty；组合不是无条件准确率保证。
rs.trigger_condition: When truncation creates homogeneous groups and unstable updates, repair normalization and exploration before redesigning the penalty.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When truncation creates homogeneous groups and unstable updates, repair normalization and exploration before redesigning the penalty.

signatures.operation: 超长reward0；每组中心化、全batch标准化；dynamic sampling和upperclip
signatures.failure_boundary: 高能力模型配不足数据仍掉点；DA更短也可能掉准确率；同质组过滤不创造缺失采样support。

relevance.how: 准确拆group中心化/batch尺度与共同系数抵消。
全零过滤可能排除需要探索的困难样本。
